transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

I came in because I can’t stop focusing on how uneven and puffy the left side of my face looks, especially on video calls and in salsa photos. People keep telling me they don’t really see anything, but I see it, and it’s starting to affect my work and my social life.
How long have you been feeling this way about the appearance of your face?

It’s been going on long enough that it’s not just a passing thing anymore. I keep getting stuck on the left side of my face looking uneven or puffy, especially on video calls or in salsa photos. Even when people say they don’t notice it, I still see it, and it’s been interfering with work and going out.
Can you tell me more about how this concern with the left side of your face makes you feel emotionally?

It makes me feel really self-conscious and embarrassed. I get stuck on it, like I can’t stop checking how the left side of my face looks, especially if I’m on a video call or I see photos from salsa. Even when people say they don’t notice anything, I still feel like it’s obvious, and then I get anxious about work or going out socially.
Do you find yourself concerned about other parts of your body or other features of your face, or is this mainly about the left side of your face?

It’s mainly the left side of my face. I keep focusing on it looking uneven or puffy, especially on video calls or in salsa photos. Other people say they don’t really see it, but I do, and that’s the thing that’s been messing with my work and social life.

Do you find yourself doing things over and over again, like checking your face in the mirror, taking certain photos, or adjusting how you look, because of your concern about the left side of your face?

Yes. Before meetings or if I’m going out, I keep opening the camera preview and checking that side of my face. I’ll change the angle or the lighting, fix my hair around the left side, and sometimes retake pictures over and over. I also end up asking friends if I look strange. It can take so long that I’m late, or I just feel too drained to go.
Do you feel that your concern about the left side of your face is something that dominates your thoughts, even when you try to focus on other things?

Yes, it does. I came in because I really can’t stop thinking about how the left side of my face looks uneven or puffy. It pops into my head during work calls, and then I’m distracted by it. And with salsa photos, I keep going back to look at them. People tell me they don’t see anything, but I still feel like it’s there, and it’s starting to affect work and going out socially.
